purpose: Public structural references for illustrative protein-binding animation. Targets and scaffold are independent; no validated or predicted binding complex is supplied.
processing: First NMR model only; requested protein chain; heavy ATOM records only; highest-occupancy alternate conformation; source residue numbering and atomic coordinates preserved. Atom serials renumbered. Waters, ligands, DNA, metals, hydrogens and other chains omitted. Missing coordinates not generated.
